purpose: Factual planning context and bounded adaptive review timing; no action selection.

dataPolicy.cropTypes: Read from the authorized plantField parameter enum
dataPolicy.salePrices: Read only from authorized configured market quotes
dataPolicy.seedAndGrainStock: Read only from the authorized farm overview
dataPolicy.fieldEligibilityAndActionEstimates: Read only from the authorized available-action catalog; planting estimates are not treated as crop-specific
dataPolicy.expectedYield: Unknown unless explicitly published by the authorized agent API
dataPolicy.cropSpecificDuration: Unknown unless explicitly published by the authorized agent API
dataPolicy.seedRateAndWaterRequirement: Unknown unless explicitly published by the authorized agent API
dataPolicy.runtimeActionSelection: None; Muse selects every management action

adaptiveReviewRules: Clamp model-selected wait to 30 days and to the configured experiment horizon when provided.
Near/after the generic 75-115 day review window for a session-known planting: cap model wait at 5 days and internal review checkpoints at 2 days.
Far from the generic window: cap internal review checkpoints at 10 days, while preserving the model-selected wait.
A simulator-reported pending completion bounds the wait to its estimated completion, with a 0.5 day minimum review interval.
Stale/expired critical sensor observations or recent material events cap model wait at 5 days and checkpoints at 2 days.
The approximate 100-day duration and review window are generic, not crop-specific estimates, hidden-maturity inference, or simulator guarantees.
